close_reason: Already minimized: function only fetches the query-result slice (not all emails) with Id+ThreadId property hint. A further win requires a new get_thread_ids backend method — deferred.
description: collapse_by_thread (email.rs:1635) fetches up to COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS (65536) email objects from the backend to get their threadIds. For backends with column stores this is partially mitigated by the property hint, but for any backend where get_objects returns full objects (e.g. all SQL column backends), this is 65k full row fetches to extract one field each. Expected impact at scale: a collapseThreads query on an account with 65k emails incurs ~65k backend read calls before a single ID is returned to the client.
title: collapse_by_thread: O(n) full email fetch per query — dominates cost for large result sets
